name: ztensor
description: Anonymous voting and consensus for miner/validator networks. Participants prove membership in the eligible set and cast votes without revealing which member they are (Merkle-commitment + nullifier, Semaphore-style). Private ballots, public books: votes are unlinkable, reward payouts are transparent and auditable. Local-first, pure python.

register.docs: {commitment} -> {index, root}; add a participant commitment to the eligible set (identity stays private)

vote.docs: {proof, nullifier, choice, topic} -> {accepted}; cast an anonymous vote; nullifier prevents double-voting per topic

tally.docs: {topic} -> {counts, total}; public tally of anonymous votes

payout.docs: {topic} -> {instructions}; transparent, signed reward instructions derived from the tally (public and linkable by design)
